buildCommand: pip3 install boto3 --break-system-packages && python3 scripts/download_from_s3.py && cd site_payload && ../bin/hugo --gc --minify
installCommand: curl -L https://github.com/gohugoio/hugo/releases/download/v0.162.1/hugo_extended_0.162.1_linux-amd64.tar.gz | tar -xz && mkdir -p bin && mv hugo bin/hugo
